default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

post.description: Administrators only. Probes the chosen disks, asks the disk guard and returns the exact commands of a destructive storage action, with a plan id to run them. Runs nothing.

default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

post.description: Administrators only. Runs a plan exactly as it was shown, as a job; the disk guard checks every disk again right before each command. A plan runs once and expires after 10 minutes.

default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

get.description: Administrators only. The snapshots of a dataset as last read, oldest first. pithyxKind is set for snapshots Pithyx took.

default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

post.description: Administrators only. Takes pithyx-manual-<utc> of the dataset now. Manual snapshots are never pruned by a schedule.

default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

post.description: Administrators only. Destroys one snapshot, named exactly. Only snapshots Pithyx took (pithyx-...) can be deleted; held ones are refused.

default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

post.description: Administrators only. Places the hold "pithyx" on the snapshot, so neither a schedule nor anyone else can destroy it.

default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

post.description: Administrators only. Releases the hold "pithyx" of the snapshot. Holds of other tools stay.

default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

post.description: Administrators only. Rolls the whole dataset back to the snapshot; changes since are lost. confirmDataset is the dataset name as the user typed it. When newer snapshots exist they are destroyed too, so discardNewer must list every one of them by name, or nothing happens (storage.snapshot.newer_exist).

default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

get.description: Administrators only. The hourly, daily, weekly and monthly schedules of a dataset; off with the default counts (24, 7, 4, 6) until saved.

default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

put.description: Administrators only. Saves the given schedules of a dataset. A schedule takes pithyx-<kind>-<utc> once per UTC hour, day, week (from Monday) or month and keeps its newest keep snapshots; it never deletes other snapshots, held ones or ones dated after the current time.

default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

get.description: Administrators only. Current storage alerts with the caller's mute flags, and the SMART state of every disk; live through the storage/alerts topic.

default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

post.description: Administrators only. Hides a current alert for the caller until it goes away or becomes more severe. Alerts cannot be deleted.

default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

delete.description: Administrators only. Shows a muted alert again.

default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

post.description: Administrators only. Starts a scrub of the pool, or resumes a paused one, and returns at once; progress arrives on storage/pools.

default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

delete.description: Administrators only. Stops the running scrub; the next one starts from the beginning.

default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

post.description: Administrators only. Pauses the running scrub; starting it again resumes where it stopped.

default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

get.description: Administrators only. Scrub schedules per pool and the SMART self-test schedules, with their last and next runs.

default.description: Problem details with a stable error code.

put.description: Administrators only. Sets how often a pool is scrubbed or the disks run a self-test: off, weekly or monthly.

AckMessage.description: Confirms a `sub` or `unsub`. For `sub`, the snapshots of matching topics follow.

ApiProblem.description:
RFC 9457 problem details as returned by every failing API call. The detail text is an English fallback;
clients show the translation of the error code instead.

id.description: Chosen by the client; echoed in the ack, snapshots and errors that answer this message.

topic.description: Topic name or pattern with `+` and `#`. A message without one is answered with an error.

ClientMessage.description: A message from the client: `sub` or `unsub` for a topic or pattern.

name.description: Full dataset name, for example `tank/pithyx/shares/media`.

usedBytes.description: Space used by the dataset and its children.

mountPoint.description: Mount point of a file system, if it has one.

mounted.description: True while the file system is mounted.

keyStatus.description: `available` or `unavailable` for encrypted datasets, otherwise null.

encryptionRoot.description: The dataset whose key unlocks this one, if encrypted.

quotaBytes.description: Limit for the dataset with its children and snapshots, or null for none.

reservationBytes.description: Space guaranteed to the dataset with its children and snapshots, or null for none.

recordSizeBytes.description: Largest block of a file system; null for a volume.

volumeSizeBytes.description: Size of a volume; null for a file system.

volumeBlockSizeBytes.description: Block size of a volume; null for a file system.

app.description: Shortcuts: the id of the app it opens.

name.description: Shortcuts: the label the user gave it, or null for the app's name in the user's language.

column.description: Grid cell of the item, counted from the top left corner of the desktop.

version.description: Increments with every change. Send it as `If-Match: "n"` with the next change of this item.

DesktopItem.description: An app shortcut or a sticky note on the desktop, shared across the user's devices.

name.description: Shortcuts: the new label; an empty string goes back to the app's name.

DesktopItemChange.description: A change of one item. Fields left out (or null) stay as they are.

oneOf.description: The saved layout of this device (schema in the desktop, `version` 1), or null.

layoutVersion.description: Increments with every save of this device's layout, 0 without one. Send it as `If-Match: "n"` with the next save.

preferences.description: Window preferences of the user for every app, shared across devices.

browser.description: Browser product name from the User-Agent, if known.

os.description: Operating system name from the User-Agent, if known.

updatedAt.description: When the layout was last saved (UTC).

screenWidth.description: Width of the desktop the layout was saved on, in CSS pixels, if the layout says.

DeviceLayout.description: Another device of the user with a saved layout.

id.description: Stable across reboots and device renames: `wwn-...`, else `serial-...`, else `path-...`.

name.description: Kernel name, for example `sda` or `nvme0n1`. Can change between boots.

serial.description: Serial number as reported by the drive, if any.

transport.description: Bus, for example `sata`, `nvme` or `usb`; null for virtual disks.

readOnly.description: True when the kernel exposes the disk read-only.

modified.description: Last change of the content, UTC.

items.description: A file or folder in a share.

changed.description: Entries that appeared or changed, with their current metadata.

resync.description: True when changes were lost (the kernel queue overflowed); list the folder again.

gone.description: True when the folder itself was deleted or moved away.

FolderChanges.description: What a folder topic sends: the names that changed since the last event, or a request to list again.

path.description: The folder, relative to the share ("" for its root).

folderId.description: Stable id of the folder, also after a rename.

total.description: Entries in the folder when the listing was made.

entries.description: This page, in the requested order.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

FolderPage.description: One page of a folder listing.

folder.description: The folder whose entries are meant.

FolderSelection.description: Every entry of a folder except some names: selecting a whole folder without sending its names.

FolderWatchState.description: The snapshot of a folder topic: the folder as the watch sees it.

diskId.description: The disk the verdict is for.

decision.description: Whether a destructive command may touch the disk.

reason.description:
Why, as a stable code: `system_disk`, `read_only`, `mounted`, `pool_member`, `not_test_disk`,
`duplicate_serial`, `no_serial`, `not_checked`, `has_data`, `confirmed` or `empty`.

pool.description: The imported pool the disk belongs to, for `pool_member`.

contents.description: What was found on the disk: partitions and signature types.

kind.description: What the job does, chosen by the module that started it (for example `files.copy`).

state.description: Where the job is in its life.

progress.description: Live in the topic; in REST answers of running jobs at most about a second old.

oneOf.description: What the job was started with, as given by the module that started it.
What the job produced, if it set a result.

errorCode.description: Error code of a failed job.

errorParams.description: Parameters of the error message of a failed job.

requestId.description: Request id of the request that started the job; the job's logs carry it.

finishedAt.description: When it reached a final state (UTC).

Job.description: A long operation of a user, such as copying files. Also the data of the `jobs/{id}` topics.

itemsDone.description: Items (for example files) finished so far.

currentItem.description: What the job works on right now, for example a path.

JobProgress.description: How far a job is. Totals are 0 while unknown.

JobState.description: Where a job is in its life. The last four are final and never change again.

oneOf.description: Set when the login is complete.

totpRequired.description: True when a TOTP or recovery code must follow.

app.description: Shortcuts: the id of the app to open. Required for shortcuts, not allowed for notes.

name.description: Shortcuts: an own label, or null for the app's name.

text.description: Notes: the text, at most 4000 characters. Required for notes, not allowed for shortcuts.

path.description: The new folder, relative to the share. Its parent must exist.

name.description: Letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes and underscores, 1 to 64 characters, not starting with a dot.

path.description: An existing folder on the host: absolute, without symlinks, outside the system directories and not overlapping another share.

name.description: Kernel name, for example `sda1`.

fileSystem.description: File system or content type, for example `ext4` or `zfs_member`.

mountPoints.description: Where the partition is mounted; empty when it is not.

name.description: Pool name.

poolGuid.description: Pool GUID as decimal text (it does not fit a JSON number).

sizeBytes.description: Raw size of all vdevs, parity included.

capacityPercent.description: Share of the raw space in use.

readOnly.description: True when the pool was imported read-only.

dataErrors.description: Number of files with permanent errors.

oneOf.description: The last or running scrub or resilver, if any.

vdevs.description: Top-level vdevs, including log, cache, special and spare devices.

PoolList.description: Snapshot and event of `storage/pools`, and response of `GET /api/storage/pools`.

endedAt.description: When it ended (UTC), if it did.

recoveryKey.description: The new recovery key. The old one no longer works.

codes.description: Shown exactly once. Each code replaces a TOTP code for one login.

path.description: The file or folder to rename.

name.description: The new name in the same folder.

layout.description: The layout now saved for this device.

version.description: Its version, for `If-Match` on the next save.

recoveryKey.description: Shown exactly once. It is the only way to reset the administrator password.

required.description: True until the first administrator exists.

hostname.description: Shown on the setup and sign-in screens, so users with several servers know where they sign in.

id.description: Stable id; file paths are relative to the share.

name.description: Name shown to users.

access.description: The user's access: read or read and write.

path.description: The share root on the host. Only administrators get it.

ShareInfo.description: A share the user can use.

state.description:
`passed`, `warning` (reallocated, pending or uncorrectable sectors, media errors or a failed self-test),
`failed` (the drive predicts its failure), `unsupported` (no SMART, see Reason) or
`unknown` (not read yet, asleep since the daemon started, or the read failed).

reason.description:
For `unsupported`: `virtual` (a disk of a virtual machine) or `not_available`. For `unknown`:
`asleep`, `not_read` or `read_failed`. Otherwise null.

asleep.description: True when the last check found the disk asleep; the values are then from ReadAt.

mediaErrors.description: NVMe media and data integrity errors.

criticalWarning.description: NVMe critical warning bits; not 0 means the drive reports a critical condition.

lastSelfTest.description: Result of the newest self-test: `passed`, `failed`, `aborted` or `running`; null without one.

readAt.description: When SMART data was last read (UTC); null if never.

checkedAt.description: When the disk was last checked (UTC), including checks that found it asleep.

SmartReport.description: SMART health of one disk as last read. The API serves it from memory; reading it never runs a command.

dataset.description: The dataset the snapshot belongs to, for example `tank/pithyx/shares/media`.

name.description: The part after `@`, for example `pithyx-daily-20260927T000000Z`.

createdAt.description: When ZFS took it (UTC), by the clock the box had then.

holds.description: Number of holds (`userrefs`); a held snapshot cannot be destroyed.

createTxg.description: The transaction group it was taken in: the order of snapshots, whatever the clock said.

pithyxKind.description: The schedule kind of a snapshot Pithyx created, or null for every other snapshot.

SnapshotMessage.description: The full current state of a topic, sent after `sub`. Only changes follow as events.

name.description: The exact snapshot name after `@`.
The snapshot to return to.

confirmDataset.description: The dataset name as the user typed it; must match exactly.

discardNewer.description: Every newer snapshot by name, as the user was shown them; required when there are any.

keep.description: How many of its snapshots it keeps (1 to 1000).

schedules.description: One entry per kind; kinds left out of a PUT stay as they are.

SnapshotScheduleList.description: Schedules of a dataset: all four kinds, in the order hourly, daily, weekly, monthly.

key.description: Stable key of the cause, for example `pool.degraded:tank` or `disk.smart_failed:wwn-0x5000c500a1b2c3d4`.

since.description: When the daemon first saw the cause (UTC); a restart starts it again.

muted.description: True when the user muted this alert at this severity or higher.

StorageAlert.description: A storage problem that exists now. Alerts are derived from the current state, never stored.

StorageDisk.description: A disk with the guard's verdict, for the Storage settings page.

environment.description: `dev` or `prod`; on dev only the declared test disks can be used.

alerts.description: Current alerts, critical first, with the user's mute flags.

StorageHealth.description: Snapshot and event of `storage/alerts`, and response of `GET /api/storage/alerts`.

planId.description: Runs the plan exactly as shown with `POST /api/storage/plans/{planId}/run`; null while a disk is not allowed.

disks.description: The guard's verdict for every chosen disk, after probing them again.

commands.description: The exact commands, or null while a disk is not allowed.

datasets.description:
For destroying a pool: every dataset that goes with it. For destroying a dataset: the dataset, its children and
every snapshot of them (`dataset@snapshot`), each dataset followed by its snapshots. For renaming a dataset:
the dataset and its children, whose names change.

expiresAt.description: Until when the plan may run.

pool.description: The pool, or the new pool's name.

diskIds.description: The disks to use, by id.

name.description: Name of a new share dataset or volume (one path component).

vdev.description: GUID of the device to replace, take offline, bring online or remove.

encryption.description: The answer to the encryption question of a new pool: `none`, or `key` once the key vault exists.

confirmName.description: The pool's name, or the dataset's full name, typed by the user to destroy it.

confirmations.description: Serial numbers the user typed, by disk id.

dataset.description: Full name of the dataset or volume to rename, change or destroy, on Pool.

newName.description: The new last component of a renamed dataset; it stays below the same parent.

quotaBytes.description: New quota in bytes (dataset, children and snapshots), 0 for none; null leaves it.

reservationBytes.description: New reservation in bytes (dataset, children and snapshots), 0 for none; null leaves it.

compression.description: New compression: `off`, `lz4`, `zle`, `zstd`, `zstd-1` to `zstd-19`, `gzip`, `gzip-1` to `gzip-9`; null leaves it.

recordSizeBytes.description: New record size of a file system, a power of two from 4 KiB to 1 MiB; null leaves it.

sizeBytes.description: Size of a new volume, at least 1 MiB; rounded up to whole 16 KiB blocks.

sparse.description: True for a volume that reserves no space up front.

target.description: The pool name for scrubs; empty for self-tests, which cover every disk with SMART.

lastRunAt.description: When it last ran (UTC); for self-tests the oldest of all disks. Null if never.

nextRunAt.description: When it runs next (UTC); null when it is off or has nothing to run on.

target.description: The pool name for scrubs; empty for self-tests.

hostname.description: The host name of the box.

cpuPercent.description: Usage since the previous sample; null for the very first one.

memoryAvailableBytes.description: Memory available for new work without swapping, including reclaimable caches.

uri.description: otpauth:// URI for the QR code.

code.description: Six-digit code from the authenticator app.

recoveryCode.description: One of the recovery codes shown when TOTP was enabled, instead of a code.

id.description: Id for restoring or deleting it.

name.description: Its name when it was deleted.

originalPath.description: Where it was, relative to the share; restoring puts it back there.

kind.description: File, folder, symlink or another kind.

size.description: Bytes, for a folder everything inside it.

deletedBy.description: User name of who deleted it, if that user still exists.

expiresAt.description: When it is deleted for good, or null when the share keeps deleted items until emptied.

TrashItem.description: One item in a share's recycle bin.

ids.description: Items of the share's recycle bin, at most 1000.

oneOf.description: For restoring: what happens when the original place is taken; rename when left out.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

retentionDays.description: Days the share keeps deleted items; 0 keeps them until the bin is emptied.
0 to 3650; 0 keeps deleted items until the bin is emptied.

name.description: Vdev name as ZFS shows it: `raidz1-0`, `mirror-1` or the device's by-id name.

vdevGuid.description: Vdev GUID as decimal text; names a device in commands even when it is missing.

path.description: Device path of a leaf vdev, usually below `/dev/disk/by-id`.

parityDisks.description: Parity level of a raidz vdev (1 to 3), otherwise null.

readErrors.description: Read errors since import or the last clear.

writeErrors.description: Write errors since import or the last clear.

checksumErrors.description: Checksum errors since import or the last clear.

appId.description: The app the preference belongs to.

width.description: Last free width of the app's windows in CSS pixels.

height.description: Last free height in CSS pixels.
